name: Alpha Wolf
description: A larger wolf that leads the pack. It has a few battle scars but is otherwise an ordinary wolf.

bite.description: A strong bite that deals extra damage

name: Goblin Chief
description: A goblin leader who has claimed some crude jewelry and a slightly better weapon than his peers.

sneak_attack.description: A surprise attack that deals extra damage

name: Broodmother Spider
description: A large spider that guards a clutch of eggs. Its venom is slightly more potent than a regular giant spider.

web.description: Traps you in a sticky web, restricting movement

poison.description: Injects venom that causes damage over time

summon_spiderlings.description: Summons tiny spiders to attack you

name: Bandit Warlord
description: A skilled and ruthless bandit leader who has established a hideout in the forest.

precise_strike.description: A precise attack that ignores defense

battle_command.description: Uses tactical knowledge to improve combat effectiveness

name: Elderwood Guardian
description: An ancient treant that has protected the forest for centuries. Its bark is as tough as steel.

root_slam.description: Slams roots into the ground, causing damage to all nearby

nature's shield.description: Hardens its bark, greatly increasing defense

name: Whisperwind, Queen of the Faeries
description: The powerful ruler of the faerie realm within the Enchanted Forest. She wields ancient nature magic and can control the very essence of the forest.

nature's wrath.description: Calls upon the forest's power to attack enemies

enchanting glamour.description: Casts an illusion that confuses the target

forest's blessing.description: Channels the forest's vitality to heal wounds

faerie swarm.description: Summons a swarm of tiny faeries that harass and damage over time
